description: Short internal records: annotation, stage report, procedure record, decision log. The characteristic failure is a softened state of affairs, so the added rules look for progress and deviation described without a number.

rules.message: State what is finished and what is not, instead of a degree of completion.
Give the value and the threshold it is compared against.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:ведётся работа|идёт работа|в процессе доработки|на финальной стадии|осталось немного)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Name the performed step and the remaining step.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:пока не получается|не удалось разобраться|есть сложности|возникли трудности)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Name what is blocked and the condition under which it would be cleared.
